title: 2.5 Firmware Update and QR Code validity
content:
<!-- PAGE 9 -->

Specification Z-Wave Plus v2 Device Type Test Specification 2021/04/15


**2.5** **Firmware Update and QR Code validity**


There is no defined test for verifying the QR Code validity after a firmware update. It is practically not

possible to trace possible firmware update paths.


If a test involves a firmware update and a tester observes a behavior not following the guidelines, the

tester should inform the manufacturer.


**2.5.1** **References**


This applies for the following requirements:


  - DT:00.11.0032.1

  - DT:00.13.0005.1

  - DT:00.11.0033.1

  - DT:00.12.0005.1


**2.5.2** **Pre-requisites**


None.


**2.5.3** **Test procedure**


None.
